chapter: Building the band: Dave Duncan, Denver and Rene Hall
title: Denver promoter Jones and the Rosonia ballroom
summary: The promoter Jones likes the band and promises return dates at the ballroom.

story.theme_name: Dance halls, lake camps and riverboat bandstands
story.community_name: Dance halls, lake resorts and where bands played

blocks.x: So we went on and we got paid, and then Jones-did you ever know Jones the promoter
from Denver--I forget what his first name, but his last name--but he was kind of small in stature, a dark fellow, he was the one who put the promotion on, and he liked my band--
Where was it held, what ballroom?

It was the ballroom right there on the points, Rosonia. Jones told me, I'll tell you what, Smiling Billy is a long way from Florida, he comes once a year, but he said I'll have you in here a lot of times, and I told him okay. But I told him then, come back again, I think I'll have a different size band, a little larger.
